headline: Storm Cleanup Continues Across the Region
text:
Storm Cleanup Continues Across the Region

Officials emphasized that no final decision has been made and that additional hearings will be scheduled. The announcement follows months of quiet negotiations between the agency and neighborhood groups. The forecast calls for rain through the weekend, with a chance of clearing by Monday morning. The report recommends three changes: shorter meetings, clearer agendas and more time for public comment. A spokesperson for the department declined to comment on the specifics, saying only that a full report would be released soon.
